k3sm dev — more than envtest: a REAL control plane (kube-apiserver + KCM + scheduler) + a REAL single node.
This is NOT kind — k3sm is deliberately non-conformant. Develop against the SAFE surface; the rest is documented.

posture: rootless (network=none) — datapath INERT (rootless): Service traffic needs --datapath.

SAFE — faithful, develop freely (real upstream apiserver):
  CRD structural schemas · SSA field-managers · CEL validation · admission registration ·
  RBAC/Node authz · scheduling · GC/finalizers/ownerReferences · conditions-driven reconcile up to Ready;
  plus macOS-native single-process workloads (Seatbelt-confined via runtimed).

NEEDS --datapath (root) — anything that routes:
  Service/ClusterIP reachability · cluster DNS · Service-backed admission webhooks ·
  the operator's terminal Ready/Endpoint. (url+host-port webhooks work rootless.)

UNFAITHFUL — won't reproduce on real k8s regardless of tier (documented ceilings):
  no SRV/PTR/headless DNS (A-only resolver) · NetworkPolicy is a hint, not isolation ·
  no cgroup CPU limits / HPA-on-cpu · no EventRecorder (kubectl describe shows no events) ·
  no metrics.k8s.io · native-process pods (Linux images need the vm RuntimeClass).
  See docs/UPSTREAM-ALIGNMENT.md and docs/conformance-profile.md for the full register.
